title: Alps Snow Deficit + Storage at 4-Year Low — Triple Convergence
desc: EU storage at 36%, Alpine hydro deficits, Russian gas ban countdown — the market hasn't fully priced the refill challenge.
edito: Storage at 4-year lows, Alpine hydro deficits locking in elevated gas burn, and the Russian ban countdown accelerating — this is a market that hasn't fully priced its refill challenge.
